card.title: More Official Than You
card.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll attach it as an appendix to mine, so lunch has a legitimate basis.
